records.jp: へい、らっしゃい！<CR>お嬢さん、たこ焼きはいかが？
records.en_original: Welcome! What'll it be, miss? How about some takoyaki?
records.en: Welcome! What'll it be, miss? How about some takoyaki?

records.jp: ……？　急にどうしたの、愛央ちゃん
records.en_original: Huh? Ao, what are you doing?
records.en: Huh? Ao-chan, what are you doing?

records.jp: いやー、屋台を見てたらついやりたくなっちゃって
records.en_original: I was just thinking I'd love to jump into one of these food stalls and help sell some food.
records.en: I was just thinking I'd love to jump into one of these food stalls and help sell some food.

records.jp: （……屋台で働いたことなんてないけど）
records.en_original: (...Not that I've ever worked in a food stall before.)
records.en: (...Not that I've ever worked in a food stall before.)

records.jp: それじゃあ、店員さん。たこ焼きひとつくださいな
records.en_original: Is that so? Well then, I'll have one order of takoyaki, please!
records.en: Is that so? Well then, I'll have one order of takoyaki, please!

records.jp: ほいよ、お嬢さん！
records.en_original: Here ya are, missy!
records.en: Here ya are, missy!

records.jp: 熱いから気を付けんだよ！
records.en_original: Be careful, it's hot!
records.en: Be careful, it's hot!

records.jp: ……。バカには見えないたこ焼き？
records.en_original: This is...empty?
records.en: This is...empty?

records.jp: ……エアーたこ焼き
records.en_original: It's, uh, air takoyaki.
records.en: It's, uh, air takoyaki.

records.jp: えあー……？
records.en_original: Air...?
records.en: Air...?

records.jp: ……ごめん。たこ焼きなんて作ったことないからさ。<CR>気分だけでも味わってもらおうかと
records.en_original: Sorry. I've never made takoyaki, so... I thought we could just play pretend.
records.en: Sorry. I've never made takoyaki, so... I thought we could just play pretend.

records.jp: そう……。でも空気じゃお腹は膨れないよ愛央ちゃん
records.en_original: I see... But, I don't think these will fill me up, Ao.
records.en: I see... But, I don't think these will fill me up, Ao-chan.

records.jp: だよねー……<CR>うーん、せっかくならちゃんとしたたこ焼きが食べたい
records.en_original: True... Let's get us some real takoyaki, then!
records.en: True... Let's get us some real takoyaki, then!

records.jp: よ、よーし。任せといて！
records.en_original: L-leave it to me!
records.en: L-leave it to me!

records.jp: ど、どうぞ……
records.en_original: H-here you go!
records.en: H-here you go!

records.jp: ……いただきます
records.en_original: ...Thanks.
records.en: ...Thanks.

records.jp: ご、ごめん！　たこ焼きなんて作ったことなくて！<CR>見様見真似でやったんだけど……
records.en_original: S-sorry! I've never made takoyaki before! I tried to copy how other people make it, but...
records.en: S-sorry! I've never made takoyaki before! I tried to copy how other people make it, but...

records.jp: えっと……独特な味？
records.en_original: Um... It tastes... unique?
records.en: Um... It tastes... unique?

records.jp: うぐ……。やっぱダメだったか……
records.en_original: Ugh, it's terrible, isn't it?
records.en: Ugh, it's terrible, isn't it?

records.jp: だいじょうぶ。初めてなら、こんなもんだよ。<CR>愛央ちゃんの一生懸命な気持ちは伝わったから
records.en_original: It's okay, it was your first time! I could really taste the hard work you put into it!
records.en: It's all right. It was your first time, so this is normal. I could feel how hard you tried, Ao-chan.

records.jp: せいいっぱいのフォローが逆に痛い！<CR>でも私一人じゃこれが限界だ……
records.en_original: Your kindness! It hurts! I tried my best...
records.en: Your kindness! It hurts! I tried my best...

records.jp: たこ焼きづくり、教えてもらっても……
records.en_original: Could you...teach me how to make takoyaki?
records.en: Could you...teach me how to make takoyaki?

records.jp: ……ふふ、いいでしょう。教えましょう
records.en_original: Hehe, of course! I'd be happy to.
records.en: Hehe, of course! I'd be happy to.

records.jp: 師匠！　よろしくお願いします！
records.en_original: Teach me your ways, master!
records.en: Teach me your ways, master!

records.jp: いや、師匠って言われるほどじゃあ……
records.en_original: Master? I'm not THAT much of an expert...
records.en: Master? I'm not THAT much of an expert...

records.jp: 師匠の串捌きを見て勉強させてもらいます！
records.en_original: Allow me to watch and learn from you, master!
records.en: Allow me to watch and learn from you, master!

records.jp: ……良いでしょう。愛央くん。<CR>よく見ているのですよ
records.en_original: ...Alright then, young grasshopper. Watch closely, now!
records.en: ...Very well, Ao-kun. Watch closely.

records.jp: 押忍！
records.en_original: Understood!
records.en: Understood!

records.jp: ……って、愛央ちゃんが自分でやらないと意味ないよ
records.en_original: Hey, wait a second, you'll never learn if you don't just try it yourself!
records.en: ...But Ao-chan, it won't mean anything unless you do it yourself.

records.jp: そうだった
records.en_original: Yeah, you're right.
records.en: Yeah, you're right.

records.jp: こころお姉ちゃん、よろしく！
records.en_original: Please teach me, sis!
records.en: Big Sis Kokoro, I'm counting on you!

records.jp: お姉ちゃん……？
records.en_original: Sis...?
records.en: Big sis...?

records.jp: いやー、なんかこういう料理教わるシチュって<CR>ちょっと姉妹感あって良いなあって
records.en_original: Well, you know, with you teaching me how to cook, it kinda feels like you're my big sister!
records.en: Well, you know, with you teaching me how to cook, it kinda feels like you're my big sister!

records.jp: そういうもの？　んー……
records.en_original: You think? Mm...
records.en: You think? Mm...

records.jp: ふふ、じゃあまずは生地を作ろうか。<CR>大丈夫、お姉ちゃんがちゃんと教えてあげる
records.en_original: Hehe, well, let's make the batter first. Don't worry, your big sis will show you what to do!
records.en: Hehe, then let's start with the batter.<CR>Don't worry—your big sis will teach you properly.

records.jp: おお……良い！　良いよお姉ちゃん！
records.en_original: Ohh, nice! I love you, Sis!
records.en: Oh... Nice! That's it, Big Sis!

records.jp: ……なんか愛央ちゃんが変だから、もうやらない
records.en_original: ...Maybe we should stop.
records.en: ...You're acting strange, Ao-chan, so I'm not doing it anymore.

records.jp: そんなー！
records.en_original: Nooo!
records.en: Nooo!

records.jp: はふはふ……んー！　おいひい！
records.en_original: *Munch* *munch* Mmm! It'f gooh!
records.en: *Munch* *munch* Mmm! It'f gooh!

records.jp: ……うん。上出来上出来
records.en_original: Mmm... You did it great!
records.en: Mmm... You did it great!

records.jp: さすがこころ！<CR>私でもこんなおいしいたこ焼きが作れるなんて
records.en_original: All thanks to you! There's no way I'd be able to make takoyaki like this on my own.
records.en: All thanks to you! There's no way I'd be able to make takoyaki like this on my own.

records.jp: ……って言っても、ほとんどこころに<CR>任せっきりだったんだけど
records.en_original: I did make you do most of the work after all...
records.en: I did make you do most of the work after all...

records.jp: ふふ。でも愛央ちゃん、才能あるかもよ？<CR>練習したら、すぐにうまくなっちゃうかも
records.en_original: Hehe. But I think you have it in you too, Ao. You just need a little practice.
records.en: Hehe. But I think you have it in you too, Ao-chan. You just need a little practice.

records.jp: いやー、こころにはまだまだ及ばないよ。<CR>また今度、教えてもらってもいい？
records.en_original: I don't know... I still have a lot to learn. Can you teach me again sometime?
records.en: I don't know... I still have a lot to learn. Can you teach me again sometime?

records.jp: うん、いいよ
records.en_original: Of course!
records.en: Of course!

records.jp: 結局、ほとんど任せっきりだったね……ごめん
records.en_original: Sorry... You ended up doing all the work.
records.en: Sorry... You ended up doing all the work.

records.jp: いいよ。一緒に作るの、楽しかったし
records.en_original: No need to apologize. I had fun cooking with you.
records.en: No need to apologize. I had fun cooking with you.

records.jp: おいしそうに食べる愛央ちゃんも、見られたし
records.en_original: You always look like you're really enjoying it when you eat.
records.en: And I got to see you enjoying the food, Ao-chan.

records.jp: な、なんか恥ずかしいな……
records.en_original: Th-that's kind of embarrassing...
records.en: Th-that's kind of embarrassing...

records.jp: ふふ。また一緒に作ろうね
records.en_original: Hehe. Let's cook together again sometime, okay?
records.en: Hehe. Let's cook together again sometime, okay?

records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
